rule: Decode the Error(string) layout relative to any base b: mem[b] = 0x08c379a0 << 224, mem[b + 4] = 32, mem[b + 36] = n, n bytes at b + 68, then revert(b, 68 + ceil32(n)) is 'revert with <string>', whatever b is. rule: Shape A 's = 0; while s < n: mem[d + s] = mem[a + s]; s = s + 32' then 'if s > n: mem[d + n] = 0' is exactly 'mem[d len n] = mem[a len n]' then 'if n % 32: mem[d + n len 32] = 0'. Shape B 'while k >= 32: mem[t] = mem[s]; s, t += 32; k -= 32' followed by the masked merge of the last partial word is exactly 'mem[d len n] = mem[a len n]'. Both hold for word-wise forward copies when d <= a or the ranges are disjoint (provable here with the base + constant reasoning of the first finding). Also floor32(max(31, n)) == floor32(n).
